a: Lasso's "tiny lasso" and vertex-spacing thresholds are in world units, so a deep zoom turns a real lasso into a click
A flat lasso clears the selection where a flat marquee selects what it crosses — the same "is this a click" decision answered two ways
Pathfinder `enabled` gates on `operands` but counts operands from the booleans adapter's own selection
Clone records a plain `duplicate` of the drag delta even when a behavior placed the copies elsewhere
`transformSelection` checks locks on the unfinished batch, while `enabled` checks the followers' finished batch
b: Make Boolean Group ignores locked operands, unlike Group
Align, Distribute, Flip and Swap `enabled` ignore the transform followers their `run` commits through
Transform Again on a rotate with a locked source answers NotApplicable, not Locked
A clone drag whose behavior claims the commit with no ops is recorded as a duplicate
Flip mirrors data-held geometry by the parent frame's rotation only, so a sheared/scaled frame mis-mirrors the data
